tutorial.title: How to play
tutorial.step1Body: Tap an empty cell once for a wolf, twice for a sheep, three times to clear it.
tutorial.step2Title: Rule 1: No three in a row
tutorial.step2Body: No three of the same animal side by side, across or down.
tutorial.step3Body: Every row and every column needs 3 wolves and 3 sheep.
tutorial.step4Body: Cells that break a rule turn red. Three sheep in a row start bleating, three wolves start howling, until you fix it.
